name: ableton-session-manager
title: Ableton Session Manager
description: Manage and search Ableton Live projects
author: iyek

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Language
preferences.description: Language used by the extension interface

preferences.name: projectsFolder
preferences.title: Projects Folder
preferences.description: Folder containing your Ableton Live Projects

preferences.name: bouncesFolderName
preferences.title: Bounces Folder
preferences.description: Subfolder name where bounces live. Leave empty to use the project root.

preferences.name: notesFolder
preferences.title: Notes Folder
preferences.description: Store Notes as .md files in this folder (e.g. an Obsidian vault). Leave empty to store Notes.md inside each project folder.

preferences.name: lyricsFolder
preferences.title: Lyrics Folder
preferences.description: Store Lyrics as .md files in this folder. Leave empty to store Lyrics.md inside each project folder.

preferences.name: notesTemplateFile
preferences.title: Notes Template
preferences.description: Optional .md file used as the template when a Notes file is first created. Supports {{title}} and {{date}}. Leave empty for a blank file.

preferences.name: lyricsTemplateFile
preferences.title: Lyrics Template
preferences.description: Optional .md file used as the template when a Lyrics file is first created. Supports {{title}} and {{date}}. Leave empty for a blank file.

preferences.name: weightCrest
preferences.title: Energy Weight: Density (Crest)
preferences.description: How much a track's density/compression counts toward its energy. Weights are relative — only the differences between the three matter.

preferences.name: weightBrightness
preferences.title: Energy Weight: Brightness (Spectral Centroid)
preferences.description: How much a track's brightness counts toward its energy. Weights are relative — only the differences between the three matter.

preferences.name: weightActivity
preferences.title: Energy Weight: Activity (Spectral Flux)
preferences.description: How much a track's activity counts toward its energy. Weights are relative — only the differences between the three matter.

commands.name: search-projects
commands.title: Search Projects
commands.description: Search and open Ableton Live projects
commands.subtitle: Ableton Session Manager

commands.name: manage-categories
commands.title: Manage Tags
commands.description: Create and manage Stages, Genres, and Track Roles
commands.subtitle: Ableton Session Manager

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the `prepublishOnly` script and rerun `npm publish` again.
If you wanted to publish the Raycast Store instead, use `npm run publish` instead.

" && exit 1
